title: Reuse an unknown affine center through value-only matrix polynomials
statement: Given X=theta+tau Z with unknown theta and g(v)=Av+c for unknown symmetric||A||<=L,take S>tau L>0,q=tau L/S<1. A shared-polynomial program approximates the independent joint target X_new~N(theta,(tau^-2I-S^-2A^2)^-1),Y~N(A theta+c,S^2I). Exactly2n+3 values give joint TV<=epsilon when q^(2n+2)/(1-q^2)<=epsilon/(3sqrt(d)),0<epsilon<=1/2.

requires: Exact affine conservative family and known bounds/scales
Supplied Gaussian center cloud;theta,A,c not supplied
Shared Gaussian power sequence for sqrt/inverse-sqrt actions
provides: g(0) plus one value per A-action,without matrix reconstruction
O(log d+log(1/epsilon)) values at fixed q<1
Full joint Gaussian whitening/KL proof,not moment checking
assumptions: Nonlinear random/local secant substitution does not preserve this Gaussian proof
A-dependent retained covariance is analysis,not automatically a known scalar C tensor I input to the separate DAG compiler
Center-zero affine N687 is already exact from g(0);this is an unknown-center channel
costs: q<1 margin,truncation and finite precision paid
Ordinary equally informed matrix-polynomial simulation matches the construction
